policy: The Android app of the current release and of the three releases published before it. docs/ANDROID_COMPATIBILITY.md explains the fields; scripts/android-support-window.mts checks them.

emulators.why: reported crash on a Pixel with Android 17 (0.21.3)

broken.symptom: Closes as soon as it starts: the status bar icon colour is set before the window exists.
broken.upgrade: Install the app again from the server's install card or Settings > General > Install; it installs over the old one.

handshake.note: Every shell in the window only checks that GET /api/version answers app = "unihub". None reads protocol, minApp or features yet, so the server must keep app = "unihub" and must not raise minApp above the oldest shell here.
